159410.name: The Friendship Circle of Washington
159410.note: Mercer Island Reporter: Rabbi Elazar Bogomilsky 'is co-founder of the Friendship Circle of Washington and has been the organization's executive director since its inception in 2004'; another of its stories: created by Rabbi Elazar and Esther Bogomilsky '20 years ago'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2004-08-09. The Mercer Island office came later (Mercer Island Reporter, 9 Aug 2011, 'Friendship Circle opens Mercer Island location': an office/meeting space in the Windermere Office Plaza on 77th Avenue S.E.). Medium: later sources (search snippet for the first quote).

1227811.name: My Little School
1227811.note: Its own 'Our Team' page (read through Firecrawl, Nov 11): 'Rabbi Zalman & Chana Paris are the Executive Directors of Chabad of Tribeca, which My Little School is a division of. Recognizing the need for a nurturing & progressive Jewish Preschool in the neighborhood, Rabbi Zalman & Chana founded My Little School in 2010.' Its chabad.org listing went up in 2010 too.
